title: 800 more Filipinos deported from Malaysia arrive in Zamboanga City

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — The Department of Social Welfare and Development Field Office IX (DSWD FO IX) assisted 800 Filipino deportees who arrived from Sabah, Malaysia, at the Zamboanga City Port on Friday evening, Oct. 30. The deportees arrived around 8 p.m. after being turned over from three detention centers in Sandakan, Papar and Tawau, Malaysia. They were the second batch of repatriated Filipinos received in Zamboanga City this year since deportation operations resumed. The first batch arrived in January 2026.
